notes:
Summary: Mid-market product company (consumer-facing B2B SaaS) — started on Hosted API (POC) for chat + embeddings, now moving to Dedicated for predictable latency & cost. Priorities: 99th pct latency targets, predictable monthly unit cost, VPC and KMS integration, and a ramp schedule to support seasonal peaks.

POC highlights (hosted API):
- 8-week POC (Nov–Dec): implemented in-app assistant and doc-search. Observed median latency ~110ms, 95th ~200ms on hosted. Good qualitative UX.
- Usage profile: daytime peak 6k DAU, concurrent chat sessions ~180, embeddings batch jobs overnight (~120k vectors/day).
- Cost sensitivity: current hosted spend projected to hit $35k/mo at scale; looking to reduce unit cost by 30–50% via Dedicated.

Dedicated requirements raised in product/infra review:
- Must run inside customer VPC with private networking and KMS for model keys.
- Retention controls + audit logs required for compliance with partners.
- SSO/SAML + SCIM for team provisioning.
- Residency: US-only for customer data (legal).

Pricing / Packaging negotiation specifics discussed with AE/SE (Feb–Mar 2026):
- Baseline proposal (Redwood v3): committed pool = 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs with autoscale to 6 during normal daily spikes; optional burst to 8 for short windows.
- Ramp schedule requested by customer: month1 commit 2 GPUs, month3 commit to 4 GPUs, month6 commit to 6 GPUs. Need step-down protection (minimum commit floor) post ramp.
- Burst policy: guaranteed baseline capacity + paid burst credits. Customer wants guaranteed 2x burst for up to 2 hours/day without triggering overage at punitive rates.
- Overage model: Redwood proposal uses 1.5x unit rate for short bursts, 2.0x for sustained overage. Customer pushing for a blended capped overage model and monthly true-up.
- Discounting: customer asking for ramp discounts (10% off during months 1–3, 15% at 12-mo commit) and an integration credit for initial migration. AE proposed rebate tied to ARR commitments.

POC performance metrics on Dedicated test cluster (internal SE run 2026-02-18):
- Baseline 4 GPU pool: sustained throughput for chat ~450 tokens/sec aggregate, p50 latency 85ms, p95 140ms for 2k concurrent sessions (batching enabled).
- Embeddings throughput (batched): 4k vectors/sec aggregate overnight when using dynamic batching + prefix cache.
- Observed KV cache hit rate improvements reduced average token compute by ~18%.

- Head of Infra: "We need clear SOW and predictable monthly burn; finance will not accept open-ended spikes."
